summary_en: Mid-term dividend raised ¥1 to ¥39/share; full-year dividend raised ¥1 to ¥77/share. Modification reflects DOE 3%+ policy and FY5/26 earnings announced today. Prior prediction issued 2025-07-11.
title_en: Notice of Correction to Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: On 2026-07-13, Niitaka Co., Ltd. announced a revision to its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending May 2026 (FY5/26). The board approved an increase to both interim and full-year dividends. The interim dividend (paid at Q2 closing) was raised by ¥1 to ¥39 per share; the full-year dividend was raised by ¥1 to ¥77 per share. The revision follows announcement of FY5/26 earnings results and reflects the company's dividend policy of maintaining a dividend-on-equity (DOE) ratio of 3% or higher. The prior dividend forecast, issued 2025-07-11, had projected ¥38 interim and ¥76 full-year.
